description: List every FRC event a team has competed at across all years with reduced event fields (key, name, event code, type, location, dates, year). Lighter than get_team_events_all; for a single year see get_team_events_simple.

team_key.description: FRC team key formatted as 'frc' followed by the team number with no leading zeros (e.g., 'frc86', 'frc254', 'frc1114'). Uniquely identifies a FIRST Robotics Competition team on The Blue Alliance.
